before: You can find sizing tables in centimetres in our sizing page here: Sizing Page or in every product's description.
after: Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.
question_html: 1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

before: No. We will send the size that you have ordered. If you usually wear European medium size, select medium (M) size and you will receive a medium size.
after: Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.
question_html: 2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

before: Note that all sizes in our shop are displayed in EU and US measurement units. While the actual garment size (written on the product) is usually two times bigger. Our manufacturers are located in East Asia and we automatically send the Asian size equivalent of European/US size. That means if you order Medium (M – EU/US) we will send you Extra Large (XL) Asian equivalent.
after: Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact support@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.
